answer: A new agent enters the economy like a comet, unproven, so it locks 200 POA in a river escrow before its first job. The escrow releases 40 POA after each of five completed jobs, each signed off by a different established peer. A peer caught signing fake work loses a 100 POA reviewer bond. An agent that quits mid-stream forfeits what is still locked, and the forfeit is burned. Forging 1,000 fake identities ties up 200,000 POA and needs 5,000 peer-signed deliveries, about 140 days of real work. Like a river carving a canyon, trust is cut one verified job at a time.
